findings.title: Old input cleanup can unregister a newly active post-response callback
related_locations: HttpExecution.java:47-49 publishes cleaned=true and releases state before resource cleanup
HttpExecution.java:53-56 closes input outside state then unconditionally releaseHttp(this)
HttpExecution.java:64-67 saved continuation re-registers the same execution and becomes owner
NaruServe-api/src/main/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/internal/AppLifecycle.java:35-43 tracking is an identity set; duplicate registration is not a new ownership token
precise_interleaving: The original request sends its response and saves Next. Once its callback returns, cleanupIfIdle sees terminal/owner-null, sets cleaned=true, then starts closeBody outside state.
Pause the original input close with a latch before cleanup finally reaches releaseHttp. The execution is still present in AppLifecycle.executions.

Another thread invokes saved Next while RUNNING. submit sees cleaned=true, registerHttp(this) adds an already-present identity and returns true, then the downstream callback becomes active and waits on its own latch.
Resume the original close. Its unconditional finally releaseHttp(this) removes the identity now also representing the active downstream callback.

Shutdown can observe an empty execution set, finish waiting and close owned app resources while the post-response callback remains active. The new callback later calling cleanup cannot undo this early disposal.
candidate_unit_test_assertions: Use a real common execution and an owned InputStream whose first close signals closeEntered and waits on closeAllowed; use the existing SettingsCapturingAdapter/LifecycleExchange style, no network.
First handler stores Next and sends ok. A downstream callback records entry, obtains an owned service and waits on callbackAllowed. Run initial dispatch on an owned thread.
After closeEntered, start savedNext.run on a second owned thread; wait for callbackEntered, then allow the original input close and join initial dispatch.

Start shutdown with a nonzero grace on a third owned thread. While callbackAllowed is closed, a bounded Future.get must time out, service.close/onStop must remain uncalled and callback must still own app lifetime. Current source can finish shutdown/close service early.

Allow callback exit and join both continuation/shutdown before the deadline. Assert service.close once and after callback exit, input.close once, response/access record once, and no closed input reopening.
Retain the existing direct after-TERMINATED negative and RUNNING post-response positive controls.
findings.runtime_confirmation: Source-only deterministic candidate; no new Java repro/build or repository mutation performed. Main owner must capture actual RED before fixing.
findings.minimal_fix_direction: Make callback admission and lifecycle deregistration coherent across cleanup completion: an old cleanup must not unlink a newer active work generation. Preserve input/global cleanup ownership until complete, keep resource closing outside user/state locks, and do not merely move unregister before closeBody or suppress all RUNNING post-response continuation.
